summary: Sandbach United played out a goalless draw against Brereton Social in a match that offered few chances for either side. The Bach made attacking changes in the second half, bringing on Fowles and Pollard, with Max Williams coming close to breaking the deadlock with a well-struck 25-yard effort that flew just wide. The stalemate leaves Sandbach still searching for their first win while Nelson leads the Premier Division after a commanding 5-2 victory over Abbey Hey.
